status: Experimental patches; application and production defaults unchanged.

limits.driverCPUs: 2 and 4 for sensitivity; 4 for remaining stages

methodology: One relay/driver benchmark at a time. Fresh relay container for each run.
Explicit readiness and post-run metrics; automatic Docker healthchecks disabled except the healthcheck comparison.
Driver defaults: 4 echo hosts, 4 in-flight messages/client, 4 KiB masked frame payloads for 64 KiB messages.
CPU deltas cover the entire multi-case run including warmup, setup and teardown, not isolated sample windows.
wrapperGOMAXPROCS is observed in the measurement wrapper, not directly in the benchmark child.
Screening has 2 reversed-order runs per variant. Confirmation has 3 rounds with balanced implementation positions and reversed workload order in the middle round.
Reported medians are medians of per-run throughput and p99 values, not pooled RTT percentiles.
This is closed-loop container echo traffic on one host; long-run stability, public TLS and production connection capacity are unmeasured.
Four driver CPUs are a controlled configuration, not proof of spare driver capacity.
Resource counters and sampled peaks include setup, warmup, helpers and teardown; sampled memory readings are not isolated sample-window peaks.
Early sensitivity and screen runs lack per-variant image IDs. The embedded runner includes metadata capture added later.

lazy.description: Renew deadlines without refreshing a pending earlier timer.

capacity.description: Limit socket reads to the forwarding buffer remaining capacity.

number.description: Parse short and 16-bit frame lengths without BigInt.

read64.description: Read socket chunks up to 64 KiB; decoder slices remain 16 KiB.

borrow.description: Write separate headers and immutable decoder payloads of at least 1 KiB; staging remains copied.

combined.description: Combine lazy deadlines, 64 KiB socket reads and borrowed payload writes.

bufferpool.description: Cache up to four owned 16388-byte output buffers per peer; return after write completion.

timerReuse.description: Keep idle unrefed write timers for reuse; hard cancel during close.

pooledTimer.description: Combine timer reuse and the owned output buffer cache.

import argparse,json,pathlib,subprocess,shutil,os,tempfile
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('report');p.add_argument('stage');p.add_argument('--repo',default='.');a=p.parse_args()
report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(a.report).read_text());repo=pathlib.Path(a.repo).resolve();root=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='relay-experiments-'))
def call(argv,**kw):return subprocess.check_output(argv,text=True,**kw).strip()
assert call(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo)==report['baseCommit'],'Use the recorded baseline commit in a clean checkout.'
assert not call(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=repo),'Use a clean checkout.'
node=shutil.which('node');assert call([node,'-p','process.versions.node'])==report['runtime']['node']
subprocess.run(['npm','ci'],cwd=repo,check=True);subprocess.run(['npm','run','build'],cwd=repo,check=True)
for target,image in [('relay','supaterm-relay-go:compare'),('relay-ts','supaterm-relay-ts:e2e'),('tools','supaterm-relay-tools:e2e')]:subprocess.run(['docker','build','--target',target,'-t',image,'.'],cwd=repo,check=True)
for name in ['bench.py','measure.go']:(root/name).write_text(report['reproduction']['files'][name])
arch={'aarch64':'arm64','arm64':'arm64','x86_64':'amd64'}[call(['docker','info','--format','{{.Architecture}}'])]
subprocess.run(['go','build','-o',str(root/'measure'),str(root/'measure.go')],cwd=repo,env={**os.environ,'GOOS':'linux','GOARCH':arch,'CGO_ENABLED':'0'},check=True)
matrix=report['stages'][a.stage]['matrix'];sources={x.get('source',x['kind']) for x in matrix}|{'go','current','tools'}
for kind in sorted(sources):
 directory=root/kind;directory.mkdir();base='supaterm-relay-go:compare' if kind=='go' else 'supaterm-relay-tools:e2e' if kind=='tools' else 'supaterm-relay-ts:e2e';shutil.copy2(root/'measure',directory/'measure')
 if kind not in ['go','tools']:
  shutil.copytree(repo/'src',directory/'src');shutil.copytree(repo/'dist/assets',directory/'dist/assets')
  for name in ['tsconfig.json','package.json']:shutil.copy2(repo/name,directory/name)
  (directory/'node_modules').symlink_to(repo/'node_modules')
  patch=report['variants'][kind].get('patch','')
  if patch:subprocess.run(['git','apply','-'],input=patch,text=True,cwd=directory,check=True)
  subprocess.run([node,str(repo/'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc')],cwd=directory,check=True)
 (directory/'.dockerignore').write_text('*\n!Dockerfile\n!measure\n!dist/\n!dist/**\n')
 (directory/'Dockerfile').write_text('FROM '+base+'\nCOPY measure /measure\n'+('COPY dist /dist\n' if kind not in ['go','tools'] else ''))
 subprocess.run(['docker','build','-q','-t','relay-explore:'+kind,str(directory)],check=True)
(root/'matrix.json').write_text(json.dumps(matrix));print('Result directory:',root,flush=True)
subprocess.run(['python3',str(root/'bench.py'),a.stage,str(root/'matrix.json')],cwd=repo,check=True)

reproduction.note: The runner, helper and patches were used for the measurements. The embedded runner includes later metadata additions. The extraction/build convenience wrapper was syntax checked; its complete workflow has not been replayed from a fresh checkout. It uses the ambient host Go toolchain and Docker architecture, so it reruns the recipe rather than reconstructing an identical environment.

excludedSetupAttempts: Mounting host/tmp into the Docker VM produced a directory; measurements use COPY in derived images.
